enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.

Alchemical (Prototype): This experimental item, crafted and enchanted at ancient Cannith creation forges using powerful alchemy, is made of a material that allows elemental power sources to be bound to it. This item is in a prototype state and is currently in need of refinement before an elemental can be bound to it.
